Name: Maximum Range Increase
Description: Increases the maximum item throw range.

Name: Minimum Range Increase
Description: Increases the minimum item throw range.

Name: Bag Capacity Increase
Description: Increases the maximum number of items the bag can hold.

Name: Bag Weight Limit Increase
Description: Increases the maximum weight the bag can carry.

Name: Time Increase
Description: Increases the available time during a round.

Name: Enemy Spawn Interval Reduction
Description: Reduces the time between enemy spawns.

Name: Enemy EXP Increase
Description: Increases the amount of EXP gained from enemies.

Name: Special Item Enhancement
Description: Unlocks or improves special item effects.

Name: Potion Unlock
Description: Unlocks the ability to use potions.

Name: Potion Equipment Slot Unlock
Description: Unlocks an additional potion equipment slot.
